title: Audit Swatch filter visual depth
description: Audit Swatch for color/image/media values, shape, border, selected ring, label visibility, accessibility text, and field binding.
objective: Make Swatch useful for visual option sets without locking it to color-only examples.
acceptance_criteria: The audit identifies whether Swatch supports color, image, icon, or token-like visuals in the current parser.
The audit covers shape, size, spacing, border, selected ring, tooltip/label visibility, and disabled state.
The audit checks accessibility text for visual-only options.
The audit ties swatch values to option parsing and field binding.
verification: Source-backed findings cite parser, render, CSS, and control IDs.
No Swatch implementation is made by this task.

budgets.context_budget: swatch audit, option parser, render, CSS

risks: A visual-only swatch can be polished but inaccessible if label and fallback behavior are not defined.
